A '''second battle''' was fought in the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

==Prelude==
Following the [[Evacuation of Research|evacuation]] of [[XQ6 Platform]] ''[[Research]]'', [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces arrived at [[Navigation buoy/Legends|buoy]] [[B-0F9]] to transfer the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes from the vulnerable [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Mharsup]]'' to the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] group ''[[Hashim group|Hashim]]'' in order to deliver them to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in a secret location.

==The battle==
But the rendezvous area was the site of a recent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack, and despite the Alliance, not usually known for attacking the same place twice, decided to send fighters to the transfer area. Firstly by sending [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], one at a time. As soon as Stele shot down the first A-wing, [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] arrived. As the skirmish continued 3 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] along with 3 [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]], [[Storm (Stormtrooper transport)|''Storm'']], which contained [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] arrived, indicating a capture operation. Stele, being no stranger to this, engaged all enemy fighters and transports and destroyed, them.

Soon [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvette]] [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']] arrived with [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] [[Nu Squadron]] as escort. Just as they arrived 6 [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] arrived to make [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] runs on the corvettes. Stele intercepted the torpedoes, and with the help of Nu, destroyed the Y-wings. However a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] ''[[Hunu]]'' arrived and started launching [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. Both Imperial squadrons managed to resist long enough to transfer all the TIE Defender prototypes and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Aftermath==
The Rebels were held of successfully. However, ''Hashim'' would not be out of the woods yet as they would come out of Hyperspace into a trap sprung by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]].

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Escort to Rendezvous ", the fourth mission of the game's ninth tour of campaign, "[[T/D Technology]]."

This article assumes completion of "Primary" goals. "Bonus" goals are that ''Mharsup'' finishes the mission intact and the elimination of every Rebel craft including the ''Hunu''. Also, 4 [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] sent by [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] will arrive, depending on circumstances. Either they arrive should ''Mharsup'' be disbaled or much later while they player may be fighting the ''Hunu''.
